name: TrueLight Corporation
summary: TrueLight Corporation designs, develops, and supplies optical communication components in China, Taiwan, Asia, the United States, and Europe. The company offers optical fiber communication, 4G/5G mobile communication base station interconnection, cloud data center, and 3D sensing/near-field sensing/flood illumination products. It also provides vertical cavity surface emitting lasers, edge- emitting lasers, and photodetector diode, as well as components, sub-modules, light engines/AOC, and other products. TrueLight Corporation was founded in 1997 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
